notes: Page states parent Nortek, formerly Nordyne Manufacturing. Page lists sister/similar brands but establishes no shared-system reuse, so usesStylesOf is null and all styles below are encoded from this page's own text only; nothing is imported from any Nordyne-family page even where serial shapes coincide. Counting convention: character positions on the normalized serial govern throughout this page. Digit-only counting is falsified on this page: it gives an unresolvable year 31 for style-1, while character counting decodes every page example validly.
